title: Conditions for Placing a Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay Order
content:
A Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay order is placed only when every condition below holds for the product ordered. The figures and yes-or-no settings each condition reads (minimum level, corridors and operators, value range and denominations, required details, validation, look-up and part payment, first-order ceiling and hold) are those of the product's own schedule.

## Conditions

1. **Account.** An order is placed only under the customer's own Personal Sender Account and only while that account's status is active. The account and its status are taken from Paloma's records of the Personal Sender Account, not from the customer's description of it. Paloma Business accounts cannot order: no Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay product may be paid from a Paloma Business account.
2. **Level.** The account level must be at or above the product's lowest Personal Sender Account level.
3. **Corridor and operator.** The corridor must be one the product serves, and the operator or biller must be listed for that corridor for that product.
4. **Value.** The order value must lie between the product's smallest and largest order value; when the product is sold in fixed denominations, the value must also be one of its denominations.
5. **Details.** The destination holder's name is required when the product requires it, and a student reference when the product requires one. The destination number is recorded exactly as the customer gives it.
6. **Validation.** When the product validates destination numbers, the destination is validated with the biller before submission.
7. **Amount due.** When the product looks up the amount due, the amount due is fetched from the biller first; a lower amount is accepted only when the product allows part payment, and a higher amount never, as no product allows overpayment.
8. **New destination.** A first order to a destination the customer has not paid before may not exceed the product's first-order ceiling, and is held for the product's screening hold before submission.

**Authorisation.** Ordering is the customer's own authorisation of payment.

Once an order is placed, its payment is collected, its destination is validated and it is sent to the operator or biller, at which point its status moves from submitted to processing.

## Condition checklist

| Condition | What must hold | Where it is seen |
|---|---|---|
| Account | the customer's own Personal Sender Account, status active; not a Paloma Business account | the Personal Sender Account record |
| Level | at or above the product's lowest level | the Personal Sender Account level |
| Corridor and operator | corridor served; operator listed for that corridor | the corridors and operators listed for the product |
| Value | within the range; a listed denomination for fixed-denomination products | the product's value range and denominations |
| Details | holder's name and student reference where required | the order details |
| Amount due | not above the amount due; below it only where part payment is allowed | the amount fetched from the biller |
| New destination | not above the first-order ceiling; held before submission | the customer's earlier orders to that destination |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical customers)

- A customer whose Personal Sender Account status is locked asks for a Paloma Airtime Top-Up. The account is not active, so no order is placed under it.
- A customer whose only account with Paloma is a Paloma Business account cannot place a Paloma Top-Up & Bill Pay order from that account.
- A Paloma Bill Pay Utilities bill is looked up and shows an amount due; the customer wishes to pay a higher amount. A higher amount is never accepted.
- A customer pays a Paloma Bill Pay Television bill for the first time to a given biller account. The order may not exceed the product's first-order ceiling and is held for the product's screening hold before it is submitted.
